mapper.sql: SELECT mp.id, mp.app_id, mp.app_secret, mp.name, mp.logo, mp.qrcode_image, mp.access_url, mp.description, mp.data_source_type, mp.linked_app_id, mp.ak, mp.sk, mp.primary_color, mp.welcome_text, mp.contact_phone, mp.contact_email, mp.user_count, mp.device_count, mp.online_device_count, mp.status, mp.creator_id, mp.tenant_id, mp.create_time, mp.update_time, mp.deleted, linked.app_name AS linked_app_name FROM mp_app mp LEFT JOIN iot_user creator ON mp.creator_id = creator.union_id LEFT JOIN iot_user_application linked ON mp.linked_app_id = linked.app_unique_id LEFT JOIN iot_user linked_owner ON linked.union_id = linked_owner.union_id

if.test: scopeDenied != true and ((scopeDeptIds != null and scopeDeptIds.size() > 0) or (scopeUnionIds != null and scopeUnionIds.size() > 0))

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mp_app WHERE app_id = #{appId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM mp_app WHERE linked_app_id = #{linkedAppId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE mp_app SET user_count = #{userCount}, device_count = #{deviceCount}, online_device_count = #{onlineDeviceCount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE app_id = #{appId}
